ambiguity.detail: Sterling and Rupert are introduced with no prior context for a new viewer.

verdict.cliffhanger_line: Then why did they never tell us?
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A presumed-dead soldier returns to his mother to reveal he was ambushed and betrayed by people ruling Ashwood.
verdict.why_it_works: The cold open flash-forward instantly grabs attention before rewinding into an emotional mother-son reunion charged with conspiracy.
